responsibility: This file implements GCC’s generic textual RTL reader used by machine-description readers and dump parsers. It defines the iterator and attribute mapping machinery for mode/code/int/subst iterators, parses nested RTX syntax and vectors, resolves repeat counts, strings, iterators, and attributes, and constructs raw RTL objects while invoking hookable postprocessing through rtx_reader. Its responsibility is low-level parsing of RTL expressions and MD constructs, not reconstruction of complete functions or CFGs.
